title: Dòng chảy xiết
story: Cả nhóm phải bám nhau vượt qua một thác nước ngầm chảy xiết và xoáy nước nguy hiểm. Hãy gặp Hoa tiêu Nami để học cách bắn neo cố định và ngắt van thủy lực.
grammarHint: Directions, Numbers & Action Verbs (Phương hướng, Số đếm & Động từ hành động)

dialogueSteps.title: Greeting & Rapids Report
dialogueSteps.question_text: Watch out! The underground torrent will sweep you away! Who is leading this crossing?
dialogueSteps.text_translation: Cẩn thận! Dòng thác ngầm sẽ cuốn phăng các bạn đi! Ai đang dẫn đầu chuyến vượt thác này?

options.text: Hello Navigator Nami! We are ready and must cross this roaring waterfall.
We are going to swim against the current with bare hands!
Good morning, we are looking for a boat ticket.

dialogueSteps.wrong_answer_message: That is incorrect. Please try again to continue the conversation

dialogueSteps.title: Request Navigation Secrets
dialogueSteps.question_text: Courage alone is not enough! What technical support do you need from my charts?
dialogueSteps.text_translation: Dũng cảm thôi là chưa đủ! Các bạn cần sự hỗ trợ kỹ thuật nào từ hải đồ của ta?

options.text: Please give us the harpoon angle and instructions to shut down the whirlpool valve!
Give us some rubber ducks to float on.
We do not need any help, we will just jump.

dialogueSteps.wrong_answer_message: That is incorrect. Please try again to continue the conversation

dialogueSteps.question_text: Here are my charts of the undercurrent. Follow every line exactly and the torrent will carry you, not bury you.
dialogueSteps.text_translation: Đây là hải đồ dòng ngầm của tôi. Cứ bám sát từng nét vẽ thì dòng xoáy sẽ cuốn các bạn đi tiếp, chứ không nhấn chìm các bạn.

cluebook.title: 📜 NAMI'S UNDERCURRENT LOGBOOK
cluebook.content: First, take the Anchor Harpoon Gun and set the shot exactly: Aim forty-five degrees. Next, at the Swirling Underground Falls, keep the rhythm and call, Cross together in five seconds! Then reach the Hydraulic Pressure Valve and shut the second one down: Turn off valve number two. Finally, at the Sea Beast's Rock Alcove, calm the creature with the words—We come in peace, please guide us.

Aim zero degrees directly down

questions.question_text: The whirlpool breaks for five seconds. Give the order for the team to move!
questions.text_translation: Hô: Cross together in five seconds!
questions.hint: Nami's secret: Cross together in five seconds!

options.text: Cross together in five seconds, move now!
Wait here until tomorrow morning!
Jump into the whirlpool one by one!

questions.question_text: Nami checks your timing: how long does the whirlpool stay open?
questions.text_translation: Dòng xoáy ngắt quãng trong bao lâu?

options.text: Five seconds
Fifteen seconds
Fifty seconds

questions.question_text: The hydraulic system has three valves. Read out the exact command to shut the right one!
questions.text_translation: Nói: Turn off valve number two.

options.text: Turn off valve number two immediately!
Open all valves to maximum power!
Break the pipes with a hammer!

questions.text_translation: Gõ khẩu lệnh ngắt đúng chiếc van cần đóng.
questions.hint: Nami's secret: Turn off valve number two.

questions.question_text: The deep-sea beast growls softly, waiting to see whether you come with goodwill or malice!
